crossRefs.note: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing…
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…

translations.web: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translations.bsb: I have seen all the things that are done under the sun, and have found them all to be futile, a pursuit of the wind.
translations.kjv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.asv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and a striving after wind.
